profile.headline: Software Engineer at CDK Global
profile.summary: I have an interest in front end development, machine learning, and statistics.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Developed custom web applications using Vue.js, Node.js, and AWS microservices. Was tasked with creating a clean, yet intricate UI that is mobile optimized and secure. Also created back-end services and routes that would be wired up to the interface. Met with clients and startups to discuss business hurdles  as well as optimal solutions to arduous technical and design problems.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: I am in charge of being tasked with working on both the front-end and back-end of the Qikpix application. Along with the web application, I also work with the team to make sure that the application is mobile optimized for both iOS and Android. During development, I have created pages on the front-end using Vuejs and have routed it to the back-end while also implementing changes to the model and controllers. Upon the release of functions and/or different builds, I test and debug on the spot.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I was able to work on the mainframe and debug and modify programs written in COBOL. The business purpose from my work was to create efficiency by adding delete statements to certain tables and so on. I also created an ISO-8583 data element spread sheet listing all of the subelements for element 48. This was created as a visual for the Stand-In team to use on a daily basis. Some other tasks that I was involved in were interacting with members from the Support team to see what steps are involved to solve issues or at least point the members of Core Payments in the right direction. I also worked on a new design application for an upcoming release for the Account Management System, and was also a technical project lead for a project on the Loyalty team as well.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: As a Software developer, I was in charge of implementing a program to capture the sentiment analysis of the company's very own social media, Pebble. Implemented in both Python and Java, I first created a program to create a query that would grab Pebble messages from the API. After this, I used Python's NLTK library to classify these messages once I tokenized and parsed them. After training the classifier with Pebble training data, the classifier was better able to cater to our needs. Finally, the process for collecting this data was automated and was also displayed on a Shiny dashboard that is a part of Rstudio. My team was able to classify messages with 80% accuracy.

projects.title: Sentiment Analysis of Pebble
projects.description: Description: The point of this project was to get the overall sentiment of an app called 'ShopSears'​ through text mining. Specifically, I focused on mining data from a social media website called 'Pebble.' I was in charge of creating software that would receive information from an API, parse it, clean and tokenize it, and finally classify each individual message. With each classified message came a score. Each score would then we outputted on a Shiny dashboard which was part of the software, RStudio. After the completion of this project, I had both a Java and a Python implementation of the sentiment analysis. Everything here was automated using a batch file.

projects.title: Janrain
projects.description: I created a testing environment using the Janrain API. I then provided a script for automatically extracting "rpx_token" and finally updated the data using REST client for testing.
